feeds.title: The Cross-Eyed Pianist
feeds.description: The Cross-Eyed Pianist is a blog about music, with a special focus on the piano and pianists, written by pianist and music publicist Frances Wilson. Get Articles on repertoire, teaching, concert and CD reviews, music ephemera, video, guest posts and other related material.

feeds.title: Melanie Spanswick
feeds.description: Melanie Spanswick hosts the Classical Piano and Music Education Blog. She writes about practising the piano, piano music and all aspects of music education. In demand as a writer, teacher and composer, Melanie frequently directs piano courses and workshops worldwide, and she also adjudicates and judges piano competitions and festivals. She has written, amongst many other publications, the three-book piano course Play it again: PIANO, published by Schott Music, which has become an international best-selling series.

feeds.title: The London Piano Institute Blog
feeds.description: Inspired by passion & excellence, The London Piano Institute offers the finest piano lessons for adults in London & the UK. Study with excellent piano teachers. Read fantastic articles about piano playing written by expert piano instructors and pianists from The London Piano Institute.

feeds.title: The Maestro Online Blog
feeds.description: Online music education platform and for all styles and levels with masterclasses by international musicians. Also the UKs fastest growing Popular Piano Exam Board. Holistic perspectives train the musician first and these intelligently inform Vocal Coaching, Piano, Singing Lessons, Organ, aural, theory, diploma preparation, analysis, fugue, keyboard harmony, composition, and more.
